gloss: to postpone; to move back (in time); to defer

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {繰|く}り{下|さ}げませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {繰|く}り{下|さ}げていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {繰|く}り{下|さ}げていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to postpone; to move back (a date or time)
definitions.explanation: To reschedule something to happen later than originally planned.

definitions.gloss: to defer; to push back (a deadline or age)
definitions.explanation: To delay something, especially a payment start date or retirement age.

examples.japanese: {開始|かいし}{時間|じかん}を{繰|く}り{下|さ}げた。
examples.english: We pushed back the start time.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{日程|にってい}を2{日|にち}{繰|く}り{下|さ}げた。
examples.english: We postponed the meeting by two days.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{運動会|うんどうかい}を{繰|く}り{下|さ}げることにした。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, we decided to postpone the sports day.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}の{開始|かいし}を1{週間|しゅうかん}{繰|く}り{下|さ}げることになった。
examples.english: It was decided to postpone the start of construction by one week.

examples.japanese: {天候|てんこう}が{回復|かいふく}しないため、{出発|しゅっぱつ}を{明日|あした}に{繰|く}り{下|さ}げよう。
examples.english: Since the weather isn't improving, let's postpone the departure to tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {支払|しはら}い{開始|かいし}を{繰|く}り{下|さ}げる。
examples.english: To defer the payment start date.

examples.japanese: {定年|ていねん}を65{歳|さい}に{繰|く}り{下|さ}げる{案|あん}がある。
examples.english: There's a plan to push back the retirement age to 65.

examples.japanese: {年金|ねんきん}の{受給|じゅきゅう}{開始|かいし}{年齢|ねんれい}を{繰|く}り{下|さ}げると{月額|げつがく}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: If you defer the pension start age, the monthly amount increases.

examples.japanese: {返済|へんさい}の{開始|かいし}{時期|じき}を{半年|はんとし}{繰|く}り{下|さ}げてもらった。
examples.english: I had the repayment start date deferred by half a year.

examples.japanese: {受給|じゅきゅう}{年齢|ねんれい}を{繰|く}り{下|さ}げれば{繰|く}り{下|さ}げるほど、{一回|いっかい}あたりの{金額|きんがく}は{大|おお}きくなる。
examples.english: The more you defer the receiving age, the larger each payment becomes.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: Xを{繰|く}り{下|さ}げる

FORMS:
Compound verb: {繰|く}る (to reel/wind) + {下|さ}げる (to lower)

- {繰|く}り{下|さ}げる → {繰|く}り{下|さ}げない (negative)
- {繰|く}り{下|さ}げる → {繰|く}り{下|さ}げて (te-form)
- {繰|く}り{下|さ}げる → {繰|く}り{下|さ}げた (past)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日程|にってい}を{繰|く}り{下|さ}げる - to postpone a schedule
- {開始|かいし}{時間|じかん}を{繰|く}り{下|さ}げる - to push back the start time
- {年金|ねんきん}{受給|じゅきゅう}を{繰|く}り{下|さ}げる - to defer pension receipt

SIMILAR WORDS:
{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる - to move up, advance (the opposite operation)
